goofy.js: Fix test iframe not yet initialized when used. There was a race condition between init_test_ui and set_html / run_js, since the document.write() method can return before the document is fully loaded, and run_js call would happen before the iframe document is loaded, which would cause error when the script is run. Change document.write to use src attribute on the iframe instead, since we don't need preprocessing on the default_test_ui.html now. Also add an invocation.loaded Promise, and chain all further run_js / set_html call on the invocation on the Promise, so the order of execution is guaranteed. Removing document.write also simplifies the test UI manager, and the onInitTestUI hook is no longer needed. BUG=b:64963909 TEST=make test TEST=manually on DUT, run test many times and see no error on debug console. Change-Id: Ieaeb21c9f615c14fea127c8a2e3d8bd7208c8050 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/727549 Commit-Ready: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Tested-by: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org>
